summary: fix(game-goat): provider-specific credential ops preserve the sibling key; reject fuzzy ITAD titles
reason: Greptile P1s on the ITAD credential path: (1) the default auth set-token rewrote credentials.toml from RAWG-only fields and dropped itad_api_key; (2) auth logout --provider rawg removed the whole shared file, dropping the ITAD key; (3) saving an ITAD key over a permission-refused credentials file replaced it, discarding the RAWG credential. Config now carries ITADApiKey through load/apply/save, ClearTokens rewrites the file when an ITAD key remains, and the ITAD write path refuses to overwrite a refused file. Separately, an invalid ITAD title no longer fuzzy-resolves to an unrelated game: a non-exact hit is accepted only when it continues the query at a word boundary.
call_sites: PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: carry the ITAD key so RAWG saves/logout preserve it)

PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: ITAD fuzzy fallback requires a continuation)
